content: Wheresoever you go, go with all your heart.
author: Confucius
explanation: Half-hearted action divides the spirit and guarantees mediocrity. Confucius invites us to bring complete presence, sincere devotion, and undivided attention to whatever path we tread.
practicalInsight: Whatever duty or interaction you engage in today, banish distraction and perform it with 100% of your focused devotion.
reflectionPrompt: What area of your life are you currently doing halfway, and how would it transform if you brought your whole heart to it?
